title: Prom and Locker
author: Wendell Voss
blurb: Odile Thackeray, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
